children: Thailand's central bank said on Friday that its monetary committee has estimated that inflation will reach 4% in the fourth quarter and the first quarter of next year.
The Bank of Thailand is closely monitory inflation risks, Assistant Governor Don Nakornthap said.
Thailand's headline inflation for October reached 3.90%, breaching the central bank's target range of 1% to 3%.
